summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour presents a lesson from Riyadul Saliheen by Imam al-Nawawi, focusing on the virtues of seeking and teaching knowledge for the sake of Allah. He discusses a hadith from Abu Hurairah in Sahih Muslim where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) explains that whoever seeks knowledge is on a direct path to paradise. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that the act of seeking knowledge itself is rewarded, regardless of how quickly one learns. He also highlights the collective blessings when Muslims gather to study and recite the Quran together, including the descent of mercy, tranquility, and the presence of angels. The lecture concludes with a discussion on the Day of Judgment, explaining that lineage and nobility will not benefit one on that day—only righteous deeds will matter.
